description: This file defines the CfAudioDeviceModule class, which extends webrtc::AudioDeviceModule and AudioSource, providing an interface for audio device management within a WebRTC streaming context. It declares methods for audio data handling, device enumeration, setup, control, and volume/mute adjustments, along with private members for state management.

classes.name: CfAudioDeviceModule
classes.description: A class that manages audio device functionalities for WebRTC streaming, including data retrieval, device configuration, and control over playback and recording states.
